subject.title: feat(ui): create catalog sessions from the sidebar

question: Should SessionCatalogProvider permanently advertise an optional model-only createSession target that opens the core new-session flow and locks catalog drafts to the validated default agent?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but this choice creates a new public plugin and Gateway protocol contract and fixes the product semantics for provider-native creation and multi-agent targeting; code review cannot safely choose that permanent API direction.

options.title: Approve the narrow additive contract
options.body: Accept the optional model-only capability and default-agent lock as the first stable creation seam, allowing future fields to be added compatibly.

options.title: Define a richer contract first
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers specify agent, runtime, or creation-parameter semantics so the initial public capability does not constrain the long-term design.

options.title: Keep catalog creation UI-local
options.body: Decline a public plugin capability for now and retain only ordinary per-agent new-session actions and catalog deduplication.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow additive contract
recommendation.body: Accept the optional model-only capability and default-agent lock as the first stable creation seam, allowing future fields to be added compatibly.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned repository member who implemented and iterated the complete cross-boundary design and are best positioned to present the contract for final owner approval.
